# required-tags

Require every Scenario to have a tag matching each configured regular expression.

| Category | Recommended | Safe autofix | Default options |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| tags | no | no | `{"tags":[],"ignoreUntagged":true}` |

Requires every tagged Scenario to have a tag matching each regular expression in `tags`. `ignoreUntagged: false` also checks untagged Scenarios.

## Configuration

```json
{ "rules": { "required-tags": ["error", {"tags":[],"ignoreUntagged":true}] } }
```

## Triggered by

```text
Scenario without a @jira-123 tag
```
